_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); revenue, net-to-gross, expense, receivables and operating-margin signals with Visa's rule-T thresholds

pit_profile.why: 'Visa is a global payments technology company that facilitates global commerce and money movement across more than 200 countries and territories among a global set of consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities through innovative technologies.' 'We face intense competition in our industry.'; no 10-K calls the business cyclical (since the FY2020 10-K none carries the earlier sentence on economic conditions and consumer spending), so the kind is DURABLE; CRYPTO is live (from 2020-10-21) and its scope names payments networks: the 10-K's words put it on the watch list, company-acknowledged, with no dated evidence that the market prices it for Visa

theme_watch.reason: Live: Visa's own FY2022 10-K says 'The global payments industry is undergoing significant and rapid technological change, including increased proliferation of mobile and other proximity and in-app payment technologies, ecommerce, tokenization, cryptocurrencies, distributed ledger and blockchain technologies, cloud-based encryption and authorization, and new authentication technologies such as biometrics, FIDO 2.0, 3D Secure 2.0 and dynamic cardholder verification values or dCVV2.' The stock trades at 27.9x FY24E — near its own median. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (CRYPTO) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing crypto disintermediation of Visa's network specifically.

classification.quality_note: 'Visa is a global payments technology company that facilitates global commerce and money movement across more than 200 countries and territories among a global set of consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities through innovative technologies.' 'We face intense competition in our industry.'; no 10-K calls the business cyclical (since the FY2020 10-K none carries the earlier sentence on economic conditions and consumer spending), so the kind is DURABLE; CRYPTO is live (from 2020-10-21) and its scope names payments networks: the 10-K's words put it on the watch list, company-acknowledged, with no dated evidence that the market prices it for Visa. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.62x; +27% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.29; conservative 2yr +21%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -10.1%/yr (worst year FY13-FY23, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +12.9%/yr (Q4 revenue YoY + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +15.9%/yr (FY13-FY23 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +27.4%/yr (best 2-yr run FY13-FY23, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: V (retrospective, 2023-10-26) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.62x (31.7% downside to Bear $157.88 / +51.3% upside to Bull $349.96) | Adj composite 1.96 vs market 2.25: gap -0.29 [MODESTLY OVERVALUED] | +27% above the EPP floor $182.16 (22x FY24E $8.28) | Conservative 2-yr case: +20.8% total (+10.4%/yr) | At 27.9x FY24E the 15% hurdle price $305.87 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; revenue +10.6% YoY in Q4 FY23, forward revenues +10.6% (Q4 FY23 revenue growth (no FY24 revenue range)); crypto is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.
